items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I made many records with her, George Duvinick DeVinney on bass and myself.

ctx.x: I made many records with her, George Duvinick DeVinney on bass and myself. And I was told by a friend of mine, Paul Quinichette, when he was staying with Sammy Davis here in New York in a hotel, any beat up hotels, and they used to eat ham and mustard sandwiches. And so when the ham ran out, Sammy and him ate mustard and bread sandwiches. Well, it was something to eat. It was better than I did in Cleveland.
And now look at Sammy Davis. He could afford any meal he wished. And that was another thing that -- shocking but just look at Sammy today. He can eat anything he want. So that was another experience.
